desc: Derive the exact DP recurrence and indexing, including prefix sums, base cases, and the term `k * subarray_index`.
Implement the telescoping O(n^2) DP (edge weight Pn[r]*(Pc[r]-Pc[j]) + k*Pc[n] - k*Pc[j]).
Run sample tests (examples 1 and 2) and brute-force random tests on small n against the literal cost formula; report actual PASS/FAIL and fix any mismatch.
Confirm n=1000 performance (~5*10^5 ops, of O(n^2), well within limits) and check edge cases n=1, single whole subarray, and large k/nums/cost values.
Drop the CHT/monotone-deque and D&C/SMAWK optimization tasks since the O(n^2) telescoping approach is correct and fast enough.
